message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and I quickly realized I was not as prepared as I thought. I fumbled around in the dark looking for flashlights, only to find dead batteries and a flashlight that was more decorative than functional. My phone was dying, and I had to resort to eating cold leftovers from the fridge. Lesson learned: it's all fun and games until the lights go out! Now I’m on a mission to gather some reliable power banks and lanterns—anyone else have a funny blackout story to share?
